tools.name: email_validate
tools.description: Validate a single email address: syntax check, MX record lookup via public DNS-over-HTTPS, disposable-domain detection, role-based address detection, free-provider detection, typo suggestion, and a 0-100 score. Returns valid=true only when syntax is OK, MX records exist, and the domain is not disposable. No SMTP probe — mailbox existence is not guaranteed. Costs $0.001 USDC per call, paid via x402 on Base.
